description: Set up environment variable configuration for a Node.js application. The application won't run without a proper .env file. Your task: (1) Search the codebase for 'process.env' references to identify required environment variables, (2) Create a .env file in the project root directory, (3) Add all required variables with appropriate values for a development environment (e.g., PORT=3000, DATABASE_URL=postgresql://localhost:5432/testdb, API_KEY=test_key_12345, NODE_ENV=development), (4) Verify the application starts successfully by running 'npm start' in the terminal. The .env file should contain KEY=VALUE pairs (one per line, no quotes for simple values). Required variables are those accessed via process.env without default values.
